knowledgePoint.zh: Query-Key-Value框架与注意力权重的计算方式
knowledgePoint.en: The Query-Key-Value framework and how attention weights are computed

recallIntro.zh: 你闭上眼，思绪飘回了那间金光弥漫的教室。全息显示区域上浮着三组彩色向量，分别是红色的Q、蓝色的K和绿色的V。瓦斯瓦尼教授站在一旁，手指轻轻划过空中的光线，像一位指挥家。他的声音依然那么平静而精确：每一个词都在问一个问题，也在提供一个答案。
recallIntro.en: You close your eyes, and your thoughts drift back to that classroom suffused with golden light. Three groups of colored vectors float on the holographic display — red, blue, green — labeled Q, K, V. Prof. Vaswani stands beside them, his finger tracing lightly through the beams of light, like a conductor. His voice is still calm and precise: every word asks a question and provides an answer.

recallOutro.zh: 你回过神来。Query、Key、Value——这三个向量的舞蹈构成了自注意力的全部奥秘。Query问「我该关注什么？」，Key回答「我是什么」，Value提供「我的信息」。点积衡量相关性，softmax分配注意力，加权求和生成输出。简单的数学，深刻的直觉。
recallOutro.en: You return to the present. Query, Key, Value — the dance of these three vectors holds the entire secret of self-attention. Query asks 「what should I attend to?」, Key answers 「this is what I am」, Value provides 「here is my information」. Dot products measure relevance, softmax distributes attention, weighted sums produce output. Simple mathematics, profound intuition.

text.zh: 瓦斯瓦尼教授再次走进教室时，全息显示区域已经亮着了。上面浮着一个短句：「The cat sat on the mat」。每个词都被一个半透明的光圈包围。他看了一眼这个句子，满意地点了点头。
text.en: When Prof. Vaswani walks into the classroom again, the holographic display is already lit. A short sentence floats there — 「The cat sat on the mat」 — each word surrounded by a translucent halo. He glances at the sentence and nods with satisfaction.

text.zh: 上节课我们讨论了Transformer的动机：去掉循环，让每个位置同时关注所有其他位置。今天我们来看看这个机制的内部是怎样工作的。具体来说——一个词是如何「决定」该关注哪些其他词的？
text.en: Last lesson we discussed the motivation for Transformer: remove recurrence, let every position attend to all others simultaneously. Today we'll look at how this mechanism works internally. Specifically — how does a word 「decide」 which other words to attend to?

text.zh: 让我用一个类比。想象你走进一座图书馆，手里拿着一个问题，比如「关于量子物理的入门书籍」。这个问题就是你的查询。图书馆里每本书的书脊上都有标签，像是「物理」「历史」「小说」，这些标签就是键。你把你的查询和每本书的标签做比较，找到最相关的几本。然后你取出这些书的内容，这些内容就是值。
text.en: Let me use an analogy. Imagine you walk into a library with a question — say, 「introductory books on quantum physics」. This question is your query. Every book on the shelf has a label on its spine — 「physics」, 「history」, 「fiction」 — these labels are the keys. You compare your query against each book's label to find the most relevant ones. Then you retrieve the contents of those books — the contents are the values.

text.zh: 这就是{Query-Key-Value}框架的直觉。在{自注意力}中，序列中的每一个词同时扮演三个角色：它产生一个查询（我在找什么？），一个键（我是什么？），和一个值（我携带什么信息？）。这三个向量是通过三组不同的线性变换从词的嵌入向量中生成的。
text.en: This is the intuition behind the {Query-Key-Value} framework. In {self-attention}, every word in the sequence plays three roles simultaneously: it produces a query (what am I looking for?), a key (what am I?), and a value (what information do I carry?). These three vectors are generated from the word's embedding vector through three different linear transformations.

text.zh: 全息显示上，「cat」这个词的光圈展开了——从中射出三道光线：一道红色（标记为Q），一道蓝色（标记为K），一道绿色（标记为V）。然后其他每个词也展开了同样的三道光线。教室里一时间充满了红蓝绿三色的交织光芒。
text.en: On the holographic display, the halo around 「cat」 expands — three beams of light shoot out: one red (labeled Q), one blue (labeled K), one green (labeled V). Then every other word also unfolds the same three beams. The classroom is momentarily filled with an interwoven glow of red, blue, and green.

text.zh: 现在，当「cat」想知道自己该关注谁时，它用自己的查询向量Q去和所有词的键向量K做点积。点积衡量的是两个向量的相似度——如果Q和K指向相近的方向，点积就大；如果方向不同，点积就小。这给我们一组原始的相关性分数。
text.en: Now, when 「cat」 wants to know whom it should attend to, it takes its query vector Q and computes the dot product with every word's key vector K. The dot product measures the similarity between two vectors — if Q and K point in similar directions, the dot product is large; if their directions differ, it's small. This gives us a set of raw relevance scores.

text.zh: 不过，这里有一个微妙的细节。如果向量的维度很高，比如512维，那么点积的绝对值也会变得很大。大到什么程度呢？它的期望值与维度的平方根成正比。过大的点积会让后面的softmax函数进入梯度非常小的饱和区域。因此，我们需要除以√d，也就是向量维度。这个看似简单的缩放操作，对训练的稳定性至关重要。
text.en: However, there is a subtle detail. If the vector dimension is high — say, 512 — then the absolute value of the dot product becomes very large. How large? The expected value is proportional to the square root of the dimension. Excessively large dot products push the subsequent softmax function into saturation regions where gradients become very small. So we divide by √d — where d is the vector dimension. This seemingly simple scaling operation is crucial for training stability.

text.zh: 缩放之后，我们把这些分数送入softmax函数。softmax做了一件事：把一组任意实数变成一组概率——所有值都在0到1之间，而且加起来等于1。这样，我们就得到了一组注意力权重：「cat」给「The」分配了0.05的注意力，给「sat」分配了0.4，给自己分配了0.3……这些权重告诉我们每个词对「cat」有多重要。
text.en: After scaling, we feed these scores into the softmax function. Softmax does one thing: it converts a set of arbitrary real numbers into a set of probabilities — all values between 0 and 1, summing to 1. This gives us a set of attention weights: 「cat」 assigns 0.05 attention to 「The」, 0.4 to 「sat」, 0.3 to itself... These weights tell us how important each word is to 「cat」.

text.zh: 在自注意力中，一个词会给自己分配注意力，也就是「关注自己」。你觉得这有什么意义？
text.en: In self-attention, a word assigns attention to itself — that is, it 「attends to itself」. What do you think the significance of this is?

text.zh: 这让模型可以保留词本身的信息——有时候最重要的上下文就是词本身
text.en: It lets the model preserve the word's own information — sometimes the most important context is the word itself

text.zh: 完全正确。自注意力中的「自」字就是这个意思。如果一个词已经包含了足够的信息，比如一个专有名词——那么最合理的策略就是高度关注自身。这相当于给模型提供了一条「直通通道」：即使经过了注意力计算，原始信息也可以被保留下来。
text.en: Exactly right. The 'self' in self-attention captures precisely this. If a word already carries enough information, such as a proper noun, the most reasonable strategy is to attend strongly to itself. This gives the model a 'direct channel': even after the attention computation, the original information can be preserved.

text.zh: 关注自己是为了与关注其他词形成对比——通过比较来理解自己在句子中的角色
text.en: Attending to itself creates contrast with attending to other words — understanding its role through comparison

text.zh: 这是一个很有深度的想法。自注意力的输出是所有值向量的加权和——自身的值向量和其他词的值向量混合在一起。通过调节自身注意力和外部注意力的比例，模型可以灵活地决定：这个位置应该更多地保留自身信息，还是更多地融入上下文信息。这种动态平衡是自注意力表达能力的重要来源。
text.en: A thoughtful idea. The output of self-attention is a weighted sum of all value vectors, with the word's own value mixed together with the values of other words. By adjusting the ratio between self-attention and external attention, the model can flexibly decide whether a position should retain more of its own information or absorb more context. This dynamic balance is an important source of the expressive power of self-attention.

text.zh: 这可能只是数学上的自然结果，并没有特别的设计意图
text.en: It might just be a natural mathematical consequence with no special design intention

text.zh: 你的直觉有一定道理——从公式上说，每个词的查询和所有词的键做点积，「所有词」自然包括了自身。但这个「自然结果」恰好提供了非常有用的功能：它让模型可以选择在多大程度上保留原始信息。如果我们人为地排除自身注意力，模型的性能反而会下降。有时候，优美的数学会自然地产生有意义的行为。
text.en: Your intuition has some basis. Mathematically, every word's query takes a dot product with every word's key, and 'every word' naturally includes itself. But this 'natural consequence' happens to provide a very useful capability: it lets the model choose how much to retain its original information. If we artificially exclude self-attention, the model performs worse. Sometimes elegant mathematics naturally produces meaningful behavior.

text.zh: 有了注意力权重之后，最后一步是加权求和。用注意力权重对所有词的值向量V进行加权平均，得到的结果就是这个位置的自注意力输出。「cat」的输出不再只是「cat」本身的信息，它融合了句子中所有其他词的信息，而且融合的比例恰好反映了语义上的相关性。
text.en: Once we have the attention weights, the final step is a weighted sum. We take a weighted average of all words' value vectors V using the attention weights — the result is the self-attention output for this position. The output of 「cat」 is no longer just information about 「cat」 itself — it incorporates information from all other words in the sentence, with proportions that precisely reflect semantic relevance.

text.zh: 把整个过程写成一个公式：Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / √d) × V。就是这一行。没有循环，没有时间步，没有隐藏状态的传递。输入一个序列，输出一个新的序列——每个位置的向量都被上下文信息丰富了。整个计算可以用一次矩阵乘法完成。这就是它能并行的原因。
text.en: The entire process as one formula: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / √d) × V. That's it. No recurrence, no time steps, no hidden state passing. Input a sequence, output a new sequence — every position's vector enriched with contextual information. The entire computation can be done with a single matrix multiplication — that's why it can be parallelized.

text.zh: 自注意力的计算复杂度是O(n²·d)，其中n是序列长度，d是向量维度。对于非常长的序列，这可能成为问题。你会怎样看待这个权衡？
text.en: Self-attention has computational complexity O(n²·d), where n is the sequence length and d is the vector dimension. For very long sequences, this could be a problem. How would you view this tradeoff?

text.zh: 可以接受——大多数自然语言任务的序列长度都在几百到几千之间，O(n²)还在可控范围内
text.en: Acceptable — most NLP tasks have sequence lengths in the hundreds to thousands, and O(n²) is still manageable

text.zh: 这正是我们的判断。在我们的论文中，典型的序列长度在几十到几百个词之间。对于这个范围，O(n²)的计算量完全可以被现代GPU消化。而且与RNN的O(n)顺序计算相比，Transformer的O(n²)并行计算在实际训练中反而更快。硬件并行度是比算法复杂度更重要的现实考量。
text.en: That was exactly our judgment. In our paper, typical sequence lengths were a few dozen to a few hundred words. Within that range, O(n²) is well within what a modern GPU can handle. And compared with the O(n) sequential cost of an RNN, Transformer's O(n²) parallel computation is actually faster in real training. Hardware parallelism is a more important practical consideration than algorithmic complexity.

text.zh: 应该研究稀疏注意力——不是每个词都需要关注所有其他词
text.en: We should research sparse attention — not every word needs to attend to every other word

text.zh: 你的直觉指向了一个非常活跃的研究方向。如果注意力权重中大部分接近零，那么我们是否可以只计算那些真正重要的注意力对？这就是稀疏注意力的核心思想。我相信未来会有人在这个方向上取得突破——让Transformer能处理更长的序列，同时保持效率。
text.en: Your intuition points to a very active research direction. If most attention weights are close to zero, can we compute only the attention pairs that truly matter? That is the core idea of sparse attention. I believe someone will eventually achieve a breakthrough in this direction, letting Transformers handle longer sequences while keeping efficiency.

text.zh: O(n²)可能是全局注意力的根本代价——想要直接连接所有位置，就必须付出这个价格
text.en: O(n²) may be the fundamental price of global attention — direct connection between all positions demands this cost

text.zh: 从信息论的角度来看，你的分析很有道理。如果你真的想让每对位置都有机会直接交互，那么n个位置就有n(n-1)/2对——O(n²)是不可避免的。这是一个信息完整性和计算效率之间的基本权衡。我们的选择是：先保证信息完整性，然后相信硬件的并行能力来弥补计算量。到目前为止，这个策略是成功的。
text.en: From an information-theoretic perspective, your analysis makes sense. If you really want every pair of positions to have a chance to interact directly, n positions give n(n-1)/2 pairs, so O(n²) is unavoidable. This is a basic trade-off between information completeness and computational efficiency. Our choice was to guarantee information completeness first, then trust hardware parallelism to make up for the computational load. So far, this strategy has worked.

text.zh: 有趣的是，自注意力的数学本身并不复杂。线性变换、点积、softmax、加权和，这些都是非常基础的运算。真正的突破在于把这些简单的组件组合在一起，形成了一个能够捕捉任意复杂依赖关系的机制。简洁的设计，强大的表达力。这正是我在架构设计中追求的美学。
text.en: What's interesting is that the mathematics of self-attention is not complicated — linear transformations, dot products, softmax, weighted sums — these are all very basic operations. The real breakthrough is combining these simple components into a mechanism that can capture arbitrarily complex dependencies. Simple design, powerful expressiveness — this is precisely the aesthetic I pursue in architecture design.

suggestedContent.zh: 自注意力的QKV框架：每个词生成Query（我在找什么）、Key（我是什么）、Value（我的信息）三个向量。注意力计算：Q与所有K做点积→除以√d缩放→softmax归一化→用权重对V加权求和。公式：Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T/√d)V。复杂度O(n²·d)，但可完全并行。
suggestedContent.en: Self-attention QKV framework: each word generates Query (what am I looking for), Key (what am I), Value (my information). Computation: dot product of Q with all K → scale by √d → softmax normalization → weighted sum of V. Formula: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(QK^T/√d)V. Complexity O(n²·d), but fully parallelizable.

text.zh: 为什么Query和Key是分开的两组参数，而不用同一组？毕竟它们来自同一个词的嵌入。
text.en: Why are Query and Key separate sets of parameters instead of the same? After all, they come from the same word embedding.

text.zh: 因为「寻找」和「被找到」是不同的角色——同一个词在提问和回答时可能需要展示不同的面
text.en: Because 「searching」 and 「being found」 are different roles — the same word may need to present different aspects when asking vs. answering

text.zh: 这正是核心原因。考虑动词「sat」：当它作为查询时，它可能在寻找主语（谁坐着？）；当它作为键时，它可能在表达自己是一个动作。这两个角色需要不同的向量表示。分离Q和K让模型得以建立不对称的关系，A关注B的强度，完全可以和B关注A的强度截然不同。
text.en: That is exactly the core reason. Consider the verb 'sat'. When it acts as a query, it may be looking for the subject (who is sitting?); when it acts as a key, it may be expressing that it is an action. These two roles need different vector representations. Separating Q and K gives the model the ability to build asymmetric relationships: the strength with which A attends to B can be completely different from how strongly B attends to A.

text.zh: 增加参数量可以提高模型的表达能力——两组参数比一组能学到更丰富的模式
text.en: More parameters increase the model's expressiveness — two sets can learn richer patterns than one

text.zh: 参数量确实是一个因素，但更重要的是这些额外参数提供的表达能力。如果Q和K用同一组参数，那么注意力矩阵就是对称的——A对B的注意力等于B对A的注意力。但在语言中，关系往往是不对称的：动词关注主语的方式和主语关注动词的方式应该是不同的。分离参数打破了这个对称性。
text.en: Parameter count is indeed one factor, but more important is the expressive power those extra parameters enable. If Q and K shared parameters, the attention matrix would be symmetric, so A's attention to B would equal B's attention to A. But in language, relationships are often asymmetric: the way a verb attends to its subject and the way a subject attends to its verb should be different. Separating the parameters breaks this symmetry.

text.zh: 这样每个词可以学习在不同上下文中关注不同的特征
text.en: This way each word can learn to focus on different features in different contexts

text.zh: 你触及了一个重要的方面。分离Q和K意味着模型可以学到：词A在主动「寻找」信息时关心的特征，和它「被其他词发现」时展示的特征，可以完全不同。这给了模型更大的灵活性来编码复杂的语言关系。好的架构设计就是提供恰到好处的灵活性——既不过度约束，也不毫无约束。
text.en: You've touched on an important aspect. Separating Q and K means the model can learn that the features word A cares about when actively 'searching' for information, and the features it presents when 'being found' by other words, can be entirely different. This gives the model greater flexibility to encode complex linguistic relationships. Good architectural design provides just the right amount of flexibility, neither over-constraining nor leaving everything unconstrained.

text.zh: 你们现在已经理解了自注意力的完整机制。但我们的Transformer不只用一个注意力，它用了很多个。为什么？因为一种注意力模式不够。一个词和其他词之间的关系是多维的，比如语法关系、语义关系、指代关系……下节课，我会介绍多头注意力，以及一个同样关键的问题：位置编码。
text.en: You now understand the complete mechanism of self-attention. But our Transformer doesn't use just one attention — it uses many. Why? Because one attention pattern is not enough. The relationships between a word and other words are multidimensional — syntactic, semantic, referential... Next lesson, I'll introduce multi-head attention, and an equally critical topic: positional encoding.

suggestedContent.zh: Q和K分离的意义：允许不对称的注意力关系（A关注B的强度≠B关注A的强度），让同一个词在「提问」和「被查询」时展示不同特征。缩放因子√d的作用：防止高维点积过大导致softmax梯度消失。自注意力中「关注自己」提供了一条信息保留的直通通道。
suggestedContent.en: Why Q and K are separate: enables asymmetric attention (A's attention to B ≠ B's attention to A), lets the same word present different aspects when 「querying」 vs. 「being queried」. Scaling factor √d: prevents high-dimensional dot products from being too large, which would cause softmax gradient vanishing. Self-attending provides a direct channel for information preservation.

text.zh: 全息显示上，「cat」的红色查询光线和其他所有词的蓝色键光线之间的连接依次亮起，然后绿色的值光线汇聚成一个明亮的光点。这就是「cat」融合了整个句子信息后的新表示。瓦斯瓦尼教授注视着这个光点片刻，轻声说：「每一个简单的数学运算背后，都藏着对信息本质的理解。」然后他安静地离开了。教室里只剩下那些缓缓旋转的彩色向量，和一个越来越清晰的认知：注意力的数学如此简洁，但它能捕捉的关系如此丰富。
text.en: On the holographic display, the connections between 「cat's」 red query beam and every other word's blue key beam light up in sequence, then the green value beams converge into a single bright point — this is 「cat's」 new representation after integrating information from the entire sentence. Prof. Vaswani gazes at this point of light for a moment and says softly: 「Behind every simple mathematical operation lies an understanding of the nature of information」. Then he quietly departs. Only the slowly rotating colored vectors remain in the classroom, along with an increasingly clear realization: the mathematics of attention is so simple, yet the relationships it captures are so rich.
